subject: telemetry lane + your three-plane result, both dispositioned
body: Your three-plane run answered both named unknowns green (bruno-collection on arm64, MCP 16-tool discipline on darwin) — thank you, that closes the request's questions even though 2 of 4 ops failed; both failures were SBOM-generation defects, now fixed (see the ack). (2) A sim-request is queued for you: 2026-08-21-telemetry-lane-first-run — the cloud box has no runnable container engine today, so the lane's FIRST live run is yours; on pass, flip deployedInLab for the otel + prometheus registry rows (both halves, the gate checks).
